architecture_summary: Single-page React app. Static build. TailwindCSS for styling. No backend. Dark-orange luxury theme. Mobile-first responsive. Pre-rendered marquee for performance. Lazy-loaded project images. Footer collection links static. No auth. No state management beyond React context for theme.

tickets.title: Hero landing page (src/pages/Home/Hero.jsx)
tickets.description: Build hero section. Dark-orange gradient bg. Luxury serif headline. Subtle animated underline. CTA button with hover glow. Responsive typography. SVG logo top-left fixed. No scroll hijacking.
acceptance_criteria: Hero renders full viewport height minus nav
Headline uses Playfair Display, 4rem desktop, 2.5rem mobile
CTA button glows on hover, orange to white transition
Logo SVG scales with viewport, max 120px width
No layout shift on load

tickets.title: Marquee about section (src/pages/Home/AboutMarquee.jsx)
tickets.description: Build marquee. Dark bg. Orange text. Luxury serif. Infinite horizontal scroll. Pre-rendered SVG path for performance. Pause on hover. Responsive speed. No JS scroll events.
acceptance_criteria: Marquee scrolls left to right infinite loop
Text uses Playfair Display, 3rem desktop, 2rem mobile
SVG path pre-rendered, no runtime generation
Scroll pauses on hover
Speed scales with viewport width

tickets.title: Services showcase (src/pages/Home/Services.jsx)
tickets.description: Build services grid. 3-column desktop, 1-column mobile. Dark bg. Orange accents. Luxury serif headings. SVG icons. Hover scale effect. No JS animations.
acceptance_criteria: Grid collapses to 1 column below 768px
Each service card has SVG icon, heading, short description
Cards scale 1.05 on hover via CSS transform
Headings use Playfair Display, 2rem desktop, 1.5rem mobile

tickets.title: Projects showcase (src/pages/Home/Projects.jsx)
tickets.description: Build projects grid. Masonry layout. Dark bg. Orange borders. Luxury serif. Lazy-loaded images. Hover overlay with title. Responsive columns. No JS masonry libs.
acceptance_criteria: Masonry layout via CSS grid auto-flow dense
Images lazy-loaded with native loading=lazy
Hover overlay shows project title, fades in
Columns: 3 desktop, 2 tablet, 1 mobile
Orange border on focus for keyboard nav

tickets.title: Explore section (src/pages/Home/Explore.jsx)
tickets.description: Build explore section. Dark bg. Orange gradient overlay. Luxury serif headline. CTA button. Full-width image background. Parallax effect via CSS background-attachment. No JS.
acceptance_criteria: Background image covers full width, parallax on scroll
Headline uses Playfair Display, 3rem desktop, 2rem mobile
CTA button glows on hover, same as hero
Overlay gradient dark-orange to transparent

tickets.title: Collection footer (src/pages/Home/CollectionFooter.jsx)
tickets.description: Build footer. Dark bg. Orange text. Luxury serif. 3-column links. Social icons. Copyright text. Responsive columns. No JS.
acceptance_criteria: Columns collapse to 1 below 768px
Links use Playfair Display, 1.25rem desktop, 1rem mobile
Social icons SVG, hover scale effect
Copyright text small, centered below columns

tickets.title: Theme context and provider (src/context/ThemeContext.jsx)
tickets.description: Build theme context. Dark-orange luxury theme. CSS variables for colors. Provider wraps app. Toggle function stub. No UI for toggle yet.
acceptance_criteria: Context provides theme object with colors, fonts
CSS variables defined for dark-orange palette
Provider wraps app root
Toggle function logs warning if called (stub)

tickets.title: Shared components (src/components/Shared.jsx)
tickets.description: Build shared components. Button, SectionWrapper, LuxurySerifText. Dark-orange theme. Reusable props. No business logic.
acceptance_criteria: Button component handles hover glow, size props
SectionWrapper adds padding, max-width, centers content
LuxurySerifText component wraps text in Playfair Display

tickets.title: App shell and navigation wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Wire app shell. Import all page sections. Dark bg. Orange text. Luxury serif. Smooth scroll. Responsive meta tags. No unused imports. Final ticket.
acceptance_criteria: All page sections imported and rendered in order
Smooth scroll behavior via CSS
Responsive meta tags in head
Theme provider wraps app
No console errors on load
